content:
Laura: Starting promo for RC rc-notes-v1.1.3. Small change set (logging + soft-fallback) but were pinning artifact and enabling traffic throttles. Window in ~30m.

Ken: Artifact pinned: registry.redwood.com/notes:sha-11aa22bb. No DB migrations. We do flip ff.notes_v1 for users group.

Ada: Heads up: please enable db-readonly window for 2m during canary to avoid write amplification from the new logging hook.

Laura: Added db-readonly for canary. Ramp plan: internal canary 5% -> 20% -> public 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Traffic throttle cap at 200rps per replica during ramp. Quiet window 15m post-100%.

deploy-bot: Promotion queued by laura for rc-notes-v1.1.3. Steps: smoke -> canary -> staged public ramp -> finalize.

deploy-bot: Canary started (internal 5%). Health checks: 3/3.

perf-bot: Observed small CPU spike on canary nodes (+12%). Not yet critical but monitoring.

Ada: db-readonly active for canary window. Logging buffer configured to drop DEBUG at >500ms flush.

Ken: Requesting +1 from ada and perf signals before public ramp.

Ada: +1 (db-readonly in place)

perf-bot: +1 (will watch CPU and p95)

deploy-bot: Moving to public 10% with throttle. Feature flag ff.notes_v1 -> cohort: all_beta.

infra-oncall: I see increased tail latency on one az, throttling will help. I'll pre-warm autoscaler for nodes.

Laura: If CPU or p95 degrades >20% vs baseline for 4 min, we pause and evaluate. Rollback allowed by infra-oncall or product.

deploy-bot: Public 10% -> 50% (staged holds).

perf-bot: p95 increase peaked at 18% in az-c, CPU stable after pre-warm. continuing.

Ken: Flip to 100% in 2 stages: 50% -> 100% with 3m hold in between.

deploy-bot: Public ramp to 100% complete. Enabling quiet window 15m.

Ada: Disabling db-readonly. Backfills (if any) will run at 20r/min throttle.

Laura: Release notes posted: https://go.redwood/releases/rc-notes-v1.1.3. No schema changes.

infra-oncall: Adding deadman abort: if throttle queue > 5000 requests for 2m, promotion aborts automatically.

Laura: Rollback snippet in runbook for quick action:

```
# rollback to previous build
kubectl -n notes rollout undo deploy/notes-service --to-revision=2
# revert flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://internal-admin/flags/ff.notes_v1/revert
```

perf-bot: Post-promo telemetry ok so far. Will post full sweep at quiet window end.

Ken: Thanks all. Closing the RC after quiet window if no regressions. :tada:
